verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to operate Pipecat itself (its CLI, Cloud, or deployments) through natural-language commands. The context-hub MCP server and the scaffolded AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files give coding agents documentation and project context, which is adjacent support rather than a natural-language control surface. The conversational bots developers build with Pipecat are what the framework produces, not a way to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
